title: Confirm Dolphin’s visual identity
question: A Flexoki-derived software workspace replaces the Workshop Desk. Lock it as Dolphin’s new visual world?

options.label: The Inky Learning Workspace
options.lineage: Flexoki’s inky palette for prose and code
options.thesis: A focused local learning app whose warmth comes from ink and paper-tone contrast, never from simulated objects.
options.viewport: A slim neutral navigation rail frames a generous Course Library: simple rows and progress indicators make each Course readable at a glance, while one blue action begins a new Brief.
options.risk: Its restraint demands exceptional hierarchy and spacing; decorative texture, mock hardware, and novelty motion are explicitly out.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A generic modern learning dashboard with cards and a bright primary color.
canonCard.viewport: A standard dashboard header, card grid, and prominent primary button.
canonCard.risk: It would work, but it would not feel specifically like Dolphin.
